behavior.budget: Persist PID and per-instance random owner token; retain live/unknown owner reservations during startup. Ordinary complete, unresolved, release, settle and reconcile cannot mutate a foreign active reservation. Same-owner transitions remain usable; trusted exact unresolved receipt reconciliation remains idempotent. Explicit successful close persists own reservations as unresolved; failed close preserves owner state for retry. SQLite busy_timeout=5000 and BEGIN IMMEDIATE retain atomic quota decisions. Constructor closes a newly opened database after post-open initialization failure and rethrows the original error.
behavior.sourceStatus: Register the existing sources:status channel. Resolve workspace and require its ID to match server-owned connection workspace context; call the existing index-status facade with localElectron access. Return indexed/status metadata through the existing transport response fence without changing grants, nativeAction enrollment or source data.

budget.controls: Live second process, actual SIGKILL and fresh-process recovery, same-PID separate module, legacy rows, five foreign lifecycle transitions, exact receipt replay/cost conflict, two-process quota contention, close obstruction and constructor recovery fault.

sourceStatus.controls: Actual authenticated WebSocket, indexed primary-ts source, warmed-config immutability, foreign/missing/unbound/stale workspace denials and native enrolled/revoked authority denials.

limits: Budget acceptance is native Electron/Node local-ledger ownership on this host and same version. Real paid-provider/background cancellation, actual receipt authenticity, Windows and other platforms remain pending.

Old binaries retain the former startup logic and must not run concurrently on this ledger. PID reuse or unknown liveness conservatively retains quota and can delay recovery; this is not a distributed cross-host lock.
Bun repeated-constructor-fault descriptor lifetime remains an explicit runtime resource limitation; full backend/platform resource acceptance is pending.
Source status uses a real primary-ts fixture. Native sidecar primary/fallback and a new delayed-sidecar revocation fixture were not exercised; existing post-await transport fence was inspected.
Source status config immutability was measured after warm workspace lookup, not cold migration. Sources UI, global-search routes and complete import/provider behavior remain pending.
Exact local CI uses a prepared private offline dependency cache; it does not establish fresh ephemeral network or remote required-runner acceptance.
Successful Electron build does not establish packaged upgrade, signing, actual native creation UI, provider readback, Windows or genuine Conation iOS acceptance.
